items.claim: Oersted issued a major shareholder announcement stating that Andel, 'which has so far owned 5 % of Oersted's share capital and voting rights, on 9 September 2026 sold 22,800,000 shares', after which Andel 'will hold a total of 43,392,007 shares ... corresponding to 3.28 % of the share capital and voting rights'.
items.source: Oersted A/S company announcement (statutory major shareholder disclosure, notification from Andel A.m.b.a.); no individual quoted

items.claim: Bloomberg reported that Andel would sell the stake 'through an overnight, accelerated share sale, bringing its holding in Orsted to about 3.4% from 5% previously', and that Andel, as Oersted's third-largest shareholder, 'will maintain that position even after the sale completes', a year after taking part in Oersted's capital raise.
items.source: Bloomberg News reporting, relayed by Investing.com; no Andel or Oersted spokesperson named

items.claim: After visiting South Korea, Oersted group president and CEO Rasmus Errboe said 'I've been impressed to see first-hand the industrial capabilities Korea has built through Oersted's collaboration with the local supply chain over more than a decade', framing Korea as able to play a larger role in the offshore wind supply chain.
items.source: Rasmus Errboe, Group President and CEO of Oersted, in a LinkedIn post reported by Ocean Energy Resources
